lines.text: Lines one twenty two to one twenty four compute the frame age: time since it arrived, plus the camera's own milliseconds.
That's zero point zero three five seconds, like the board. Line one twenty five skips anything older than a quarter second.
Lines one twenty eight and one twenty nine rewind: the wheel pose at now minus frame age, twelve point four six five seconds.
That lands in Wheel Odometry. Lines twenty three and twenty four create its history buffer, one and a half seconds long.
Its update runs two hundred fifty times a second; line forty two stores each pose with its timestamp.
Get pose at, line fifty seven, blends the two samples around our time: one, zero point five, zero degrees.
Each method is synchronized, because the wheel thread writes while the main loop reads.
Back in Tag Tracker, line one thirty skips the photo if the memory has no answer yet.
Line one thirty four flattens the 3D pose onto the floor: two point zero zero, zero point one zero, one eighty degrees.
Line one thirty six applies the camera's fix, A composed with measured. Our fix is still zero, so nothing changes yet.
Line one thirty seven checks ambiguity, zero point one, fine. Line one thirty eight composes robot and tag, three, zero point six, and calls fuse.
